description: 电商业务评测数据集 — 5张表 (users/products/orders/order_items/categories)，覆盖基础查询到复杂分析

test_cases.question: 列出所有上架中的商品名称和价格
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY price DESC

test_cases.question: 统计每个类目下有多少个商品
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC

test_cases.question: 查询售价最高的 5 个商品
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5

test_cases.question: 统计每个状态的订单数量
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC

test_cases.question: 查询北京的用户列表
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT name, email, phone, vip_level FROM users WHERE city = '北京' ORDER BY vip_level DESC

test_cases.question: 统计库存不足 10 件的商品 (仅上架商品)
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT name, stock FROM products WHERE status = 'active' AND stock < 10 ORDER BY stock ASC

test_cases.question: 查询每个商品的平均利润率 (售价-成本)/售价
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT name, price, cost, ROUND((price - cost) / price * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct FROM products WHERE price > 0 ORDER BY profit_margin_pct DESC

test_cases.question: 查询2024年1月的订单总金额
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(actual_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01' AND status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')

test_cases.question: 按照注册月份统计新用户数量
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(registered_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM users GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(registered_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

test_cases.question: 查询年龄在25-35岁之间的女性用户
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT name, age, city FROM users WHERE age BETWEEN 25 AND 35 AND gender = 'female' ORDER BY age

test_cases.question: 查询每个用户的订单数和总消费金额，按消费金额降序排列
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.actual_amount), 0) AS total_spent FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 20

test_cases.question: 找出购买过'iPhone 15 Pro'的用户及其购买时间
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name, u.email, o.created_at AS purchase_time FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.name = 'iPhone 15 Pro' AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

test_cases.question: 统计每个类目的总销售额 (通过订单明细)
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) AS total_sales FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_sales DESC

test_cases.question: 查询2024年每个月的订单量和总销售额
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(actual_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' AND status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

test_cases.question: 查询每个商品被购买的总数量 (销量)，只看已完成的订单
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_sold DESC

test_cases.question: 找出过去30天内没有下过单的用户
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, u.last_login_at FROM users u WHERE u.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT o.user_id FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) ORDER BY u.last_login_at DESC

test_cases.question: 按城市统计用户数量，只显示用户数超过50的城市
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY user_count DESC

test_cases.question: 计算订单的平均折扣率 (折扣金额/总金额)
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(discount_amount / NULLIF(total_amount, 0)) * 100, 2) AS avg_discount_pct FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 0 AND status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')

test_cases.question: 查询客单价最高的前10个用户 (客单价 = 总消费/订单数)
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.actual_amount), 0) AS total_spent, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.actual_amount), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(o.id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY u.id, u.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 0 ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 10

test_cases.question: 查询同时包含'A类'和'B类'商品类目的订单 (此订单中至少有一个A类商品和一个B类商品)
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.created_at FROM orders o WHERE o.id IN (SELECT oi1.order_id FROM order_items oi1 JOIN products p1 ON oi1.product_id = p1.id JOIN categories c1 ON p1.category_id = c1.id WHERE c1.name = '数码电子') AND o.id IN (SELECT oi2.order_id FROM order_items oi2 JOIN products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.id JOIN categories c2 ON p2.category_id = c2.id WHERE c2.name = '图书音像') ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

test_cases.question: 查询销售额最高的5个商品的毛利率
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total_revenue, SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost) AS total_cost, ROUND((SUM(oi.subtotal) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

test_cases.question: 找出重复下单率最高的城市 (重复下单 = 同一用户在同一城市下单超过1次)
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT u.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS unique_users, COUNT(o.id) AS total_orders, ROUND(COUNT(o.id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id), 0), 2) AS orders_per_user FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.city IS NOT NULL AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY u.city HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) >= 10 ORDER BY orders_per_user DESC

test_cases.question: 查询销售额占整个商城总销售额超过5%的类目
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS category_revenue, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal) / (SELECT SUM(oi2.subtotal) FROM order_items oi2 JOIN orders o2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.id WHERE o2.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')) * 100, 2) AS revenue_pct FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING revenue_pct > 5 ORDER BY revenue_pct DESC

test_cases.question: 按月统计新增用户的7日留存率 (注册后7天内至少下过一单的比例)
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(u.registered_at, '%Y-%m') AS cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.created_at <= DATE_ADD(u.registered_at, INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN u.id END) AS retained_users, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.created_at <= DATE_ADD(u.registered_at, INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN u.id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0), 2) AS retention_pct FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id AND o.created_at >= u.registered_at WHERE u.registered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.registered_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(u.registered_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY cohort_month

test_cases.question: 使用窗口函数计算每个商品在其类目中的销售额排名
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, p.name AS product, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.subtotal) DESC) AS category_rank FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY c.id, c.name, p.id, p.name ORDER BY c.name, category_rank

test_cases.question: 计算订单金额的月度环比增长率
test_cases.gold_sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(actual_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m')) SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue, ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM monthly_revenue ORDER BY month

test_cases.question: 使用 RFM 分析找出'重要价值客户' (最近30天有消费 + 消费金额前20% + 消费频次前20%)
test_cases.gold_sql: WITH user_rfm AS (SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, DATEDIFF(NOW(), MAX(o.created_at)) AS recency, COUNT(o.id) AS frequency, COALESCE(SUM(o.actual_amount), 0) AS monetary FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY u.id, u.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 0) SELECT name, recency, frequency, monetary FROM user_rfm WHERE recency <= 30 AND monetary >= (SELECT MIN(monetary) FROM (SELECT monetary, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS bucket FROM user_rfm) t WHERE bucket = 1) AND frequency >= (SELECT MIN(frequency) FROM (SELECT frequency, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS bucket FROM user_rfm) t WHERE bucket = 1) ORDER BY monetary DESC

test_cases.question: 找出连续3个月消费金额都在增长的VIP用户
test_cases.gold_sql: WITH monthly_spend AS (SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(o.actual_amount) AS monthly_amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.vip_level > 0 AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY u.id, u.name, DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m')), spend_with_growth AS (SELECT user_id, name, month, monthly_amount, CASE WHEN monthly_amount > LAG(monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY month) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_growth FROM monthly_spend), consecutive_growth AS (SELECT user_id, name, SUM(is_growth) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS growth_streak, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS months_count FROM spend_with_growth) SELECT DISTINCT name FROM consecutive_growth WHERE growth_streak = 3 AND months_count = 3

test_cases.question: 查询从未被退货的商品的复购率 (复购 = 同一用户购买超过1次)
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS buyer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_purchase_count.purchase_times > 1 THEN o.user_id END) AS repeat_buyer_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_purchase_count.purchase_times > 1 THEN o.user_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id), 0), 2) AS repurchase_rate_pct FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') LEFT JOIN (SELECT oi2.product_id, o2.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o2.id) AS purchase_times FROM order_items oi2 JOIN orders o2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.id WHERE o2.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY oi2.product_id, o2.user_id) user_purchase_count ON p.id = user_purchase_count.product_id AND o.user_id = user_purchase_count.user_id WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT oi3.product_id FROM order_items oi3 JOIN orders o3 ON oi3.order_id = o3.id WHERE o3.status = 'refunded') GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) >= 5 ORDER BY repurchase_rate_pct DESC

test_cases.question: 将商品按价格分为'低端' (<50), '中端' (50-200), '高端' (200-1000), '奢侈品' (>1000)，统计每个档位的商品数和平均销量
test_cases.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.price < 50 THEN '低端' WHEN p.price BETWEEN 50 AND 200 THEN '中端' WHEN p.price BETWEEN 200 AND 1000 THEN '高端' ELSE '奢侈品' END AS price_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(sold.total_qty, 0)), 0) AS avg_units_sold FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY oi.product_id) sold ON p.id = sold.product_id WHERE p.status = 'active' GROUP BY price_tier ORDER BY MIN(p.price)
